title: Brasaland telemetry event 1.0.0
description: Design only. Closed envelope and 47 closed event payloads. x-delivery is a processing-policy annotation, not emitted data. Descriptions on referenced definitions apply to each use. Fields absent from required are optional and omitted when unknown.

timestamp.description: UTC observation time, not the editable movement date. ISO 8601/RFC 3339.

sessionId.description: Anonymous browser-tab identifier, never an authenticated session. Null for API requests without validated browser context.

userId.description: No authentication exists. Never derive from autor, IP, session or device.

event_type.description: Exact Phase 1 name, discriminated by oneOf.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version, independent of application release.

requestId.description: One validated HTTP request identifier, shared with logs. Null for non-request or multi-request activity.

properties.description: Allowlist selected by event_type; no arbitrary attributes.

source.description: Actual emitter, restricted further by each variant.

environment.description: Trusted deployment configuration, never a client URL.

_uuid.description: Lowercase random UUID v4, validated before emission. No names or arbitrary caller-supplied identifiers.

_articleId.description: Opaque ID of an existing backend article. Internal operational data; never article name.

_localId.description: Opaque ID of an existing backend local. Restricted operational location reference; no name, address or coordinates.

_movementId.description: Opaque ID of a successfully registered movement, not the event identifier.

_incidentId.description: Opaque ID of an existing incident, never an author or report text.

_formAttemptId.description: Anonymous form editing attempt. Optional on API events without validated browser context; never an idempotency key.

_decimal.description: Finite exact decimal string, canonical notation without exponent. Confidential inventory quantity; no currency.

_nonzeroDecimal.description: Nonzero exact movement quantity; positive entry/exit amount or signed adjustment. Validate direction in emitter.

_nonnegativeDecimal.description: Finite nonnegative stock or reorder threshold, as exact decimal string.

_count.description: Nonnegative count, not an identifier or free-form value.

_durationMs.description: Elapsed milliseconds from a monotonic clock; finite, maximum one day. Not a wall-clock timestamp.

_movementType.description: Validated movement direction from the actual domain enum.

_unit.description: Actual article unit enum. No implicit conversion or cross-unit summation.

_category.description: Article category enum; excludes article names.

_status.description: Existing incident status enum; no assumed transition sequence.

_severity.description: Existing incident severity enum, not personal data.

_area.description: Responsible department enum, never an employee name.

_channel.description: Report channel enum, never phone number or email address.

_incidentType.description: Incident classification enum, not report contents.

_method.description: Normalized HTTP verb, never arbitrary request text.

_route.description: Allowlisted route template only. Remove query, fragment, host and dynamic IDs. Unknown routes map to other.

_httpStatus.description: Actual HTTP status. Omit if no response exists; never invent a status for network failures.

_field.description: Known field name only; unknown paths map to unknown. Never field values or arbitrary nested paths.

_rule.description: Sanitized validation rule code, not a validator message or input value.

_issues.description: At most 16 distinct sanitized field/rule pairs. Truncate excess pairs, not values; never include raw errors.

_formType.description: Known UI form, not a DOM selector or field content.

_operation.description: Known operation from existing UI handlers; no arbitrary function names.

_view.description: Existing operational tab, not a full URL.

_module.description: Controlled module label, never a file path or stack trace.

_errorFamily.description: Mapped exception family; unknown custom exceptions map to unknown without their message.

_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of release, controlled module, family and sanitized internal code only. Never hash raw message, stack, user input or IP. Omit if sanitization cannot be ensured.

_release.description: Configured application release number, excluding branch names, usernames and URLs.

_outcome.description: Observed completion result. Cancellation is not a backend business rejection.

_loadKind.description: View/document load context used to compare cold and repeated loads.

_filters.description: Only validated incident filter enums; absence means no filter. Never a raw query string.

_changedFields.description: Names of unsaved tracking fields, never their text or author input.

_querySource.description: Actual browser stock lookup trigger; distinguish manual demand from automatic refresh.

_cache.description: Existing per-process catalog cache. No stock cache is assumed.

inventory.movement_received.description: POST /inventory/movements arrival before model validation. Not a persisted movement. Only include movementType if safely parsed as a known enum; do not inspect malformed bodies for telemetry.

inventory.movement_validation_failed.description: Movement request rejected by schema or quantity validation, before storage mutation. No raw validation errors or submitted values.

inventory.movement_reference_rejected.description: Movement rejected for missing article or local. Never emit the untrusted missing identifier or error detail.

missingEntity.description: First missing reference detected by storage.

inventory.movement_negative_stock_reject.description: Validated outgoing movement or negative adjustment would leave stock below zero; nothing appended. Emitter must verify stock + signed delta < 0.

movementType.description: Only these types can decrease stock.

inventory.movement_created.description: Movement actually appended and acknowledged with 201. Entry/exit quantity positive, adjustment signed. Emitter verifies nonnegative stockAfter using Decimal, not telemetry arithmetic.

inventory.reorder_signal_active.description: Observed successful stock response with stock strictly below threshold. Not a threshold crossing, notification sent or unique shortage episode. Emitter checks stock < reorderPoint.

belowReorderPoint.description: Only active signal evaluations belong to this event.

inventory.direct_stock_write_rejected.description: Method-not-allowed response to a write verb on the exact stock read route. Not evidence of malicious intent or authenticated access.

route.description: Exact route only; no query string.

httpStatus.description: Framework method rejection, not a stock validator error.

inventory.article_created.description: Successful article catalog creation, excluding its free-text name.

inventory.local_created.description: Successful local catalog creation. No local name, country or physical address.

inventory.catalog_validation_failed.description: Article/local creation 422 mapped to controlled field/rule pairs.

inventory.stock_lookup_completed.description: Successful browser stock lookup, separating manual demand, automatic batch and post-write refresh.

belowReorderPoint.description: Last returned flag in the window; not a frontend threshold calculation.

observationCount.description: Successful lookups represented, not changes in stock. Manual/post-write events always represent one lookup.

windowMs.description: Aggregation span in milliseconds. Zero for a single immediate lookup; stock is the last observed value, never an average.

inventory.movement_history_loaded.description: Successful list_movements response; quantify result size and actual API filters without copying movements.

inventory.reorder_indicator_displayed.description: An active signal actually displayed, not every React render and not proof of operator attention.

incident.created.description: Incident registered with initial Abierta status; exclude author and all free text.

status.description: Actual initial state imposed by router.

incident.validation_failed.description: 422 on incident creation, update or filter validation. Do not claim empty author is rejected by backend.

route.description: Incident route template without identifier or filters.

incident.status_changed.description: Effective status change with a history record; emitter checks oldStatus != newStatus. Area and severity are current known incident enums.

incident.area_changed.description: Effective department reassignment; emitter checks oldArea != newArea. No staff identity.

incident.update_noop.description: PATCH succeeds but creates no status/area history entry, although updated_at changes.

incident.history_loaded.description: Sorted history included in successful detail response; never include history authors or values as arbitrary text.

incident.not_found.description: Missing incident on read/update. Omit untrusted requested ID and error message.

navigation.section_viewed.description: Initial tab or effective activeView change, not repeated clicks on the active tab.

trigger.description: Initial display or actual tab transition.

inventory.article_selected.description: Explicit article choice; exclude automatic first-item defaults.

surface.description: Actual selection control, not stock query selector.

incident.detail_opened.description: Detail opened from a table interaction or automatically after successful creation.

trigger.description: Observed entry point into the drawer.

incident.filters_applied.description: Stable incident filters actually applied; debounce telemetry only, not existing UI requests.

incident.filter_empty_result.description: Successful filtered request returned no rows. Not a loading/error state; emitter checks at least one active filter.

filters.description: Nonempty set of actual validated filters.

rowCount.description: Empty successful result, not missing response.

form.started.description: First real edit of a form attempt, not initial display or each keystroke.

form.abandoned.description: Inferred discard of an edited creation form without confirmed success or in-flight write. Exclude preserved App form and use incident.edit_discarded for drawer edits.

formType.description: Creation form actually discarded, not merely hidden.

reason.description: Observed discard boundary; no inferred employee intention.

inferred.description: Browser lifecycle inference, not proof no write occurred.

inventory.prerequisite_blocked.description: Movement action disabled after initial load because a catalog is empty, not while loading or saving.

missing.description: Missing catalog prerequisite, never location names.

incident.edit_discarded.description: Unsaved status/area edit lost by drawer closure or replacement, excluding writes in flight.

reason.description: Actual lifecycle boundary losing the edits.

form.validation_blocked.description: Native invalid control or explicit blank-author guard prevents submission before API. No input values.

performance.api_response_timed.description: Existing middleware timing, adapted to sanitized route templates. Preserve failed timings, without exception bodies.

performance.client_request_completed.description: Browser HTTP attempt including body decode, with optional status only when a response was observed.

performance.backoffice_initial_load_comp.description: Initial incidents view usable or definitively failed. Multi-request measurement has requestId null.

duplicateRequestCount.description: Extra equivalent requests for the same initial data, distinguished from development StrictMode effects.

documentLoadMs.description: Optional navigation-entry document load duration if observable.

performance.inventory_view_load_complete.description: Tab selection through lazy module and initial inventory data; batch badge completion measured separately. requestId null.

moduleLoadMs.description: Elapsed lazy-module wait, zero if already available.

performance.incident_detail_load_complet.description: Drawer selection through module/data availability or failure, separate from tab load. requestId null for combined phases.

moduleLoadMs.description: Lazy detail-module wait, zero when cached.

performance.reorder_batch_completed.description: One existing frontend fan-out completion, failure or cancellation; emitter verifies successfulCount + failedCount <= articleCount. No single requestId.

performance.inventory_cache_lookup.description: One cache get_or_load outcome, measuring lookup/load wait without serializing cached values.

result.description: Whether a still-valid entry was used.

ttlSeconds.description: Configured cache TTL; currently articles=300, locals=900.

performance.inventory_cache_invalidated.description: Catalog invalidation after successful creation; do not claim movements invalidate a stock cache.

frontend.uncaught_exception.description: Execution/render exception escaping local handlers; future global/boundary capture. Never raw stack or message.

frontend.unhandled_rejection.description: Rejected promise without handler, not a fetch error already handled by a form. Omit arbitrary rejection values.

frontend.lazy_module_failed.description: Failed lazy code download, not failed API data loading; use this most specific event for the occurrence.

module.description: One of the two existing lazy imports; never an asset URL.

api.network_failed.description: Browser fetch rejected without accessible HTTP response. Cannot reliably distinguish CORS from network failure.

failureKind.description: Conservative classification without claiming unobservable cause.

api.response_decode_failed.description: Successful HTTP response could not be parsed as JSON. Excludes deliberate fallback for non-JSON HTTP error bodies.

httpStatus.description: Observed successful response status whose body decoding failed.

ui.operation_failed.description: Handled error shown by UI for an operation, excluding known successful write followed by refresh failure. This is an exposure metric, not another business rejection.

errorKind.description: Mapped cause, never the UI message.

ui.post_write_refresh_failed.description: Write already confirmed; subsequent data refresh failed. Correlate attempt, not a fictitious failed write. requestId is the failed refresh request if known, otherwise null.

operation.description: Write known to have succeeded before refresh.

writeConfirmed.description: Do not emit this when success was never confirmed.

refreshStage.description: Known failed read phase; no response body.

api.unhandled_exception.description: Unhandled server exception at call_next, distinct from controlled business 4xx responses.

httpStatus.description: Server failure status used by middleware.

operations.health_check_completed.description: Actual health-check attempt. API can observe only received requests; external probe needed for timeout or absent response. Does not check persistence or external providers.

outcome.description: Observed probe result, not an assumed service-wide diagnosis.
